Name: The Mothers Circle - Beta
Author: oNIGHTLUGA25
Description:
Pode substituir o texto de exemplo por esta descrição em inglês.
[heading]The Mothers’ Circle[/heading]
The Mothers’ Circle adds a pregnancy storyline to Stardew Valley. When your farmer or their NPC spouse becomes pregnant, the story unfolds through letters, visits, and gatherings at the Stardrop Saloon. Jodi and the other women share their experiences, and a choice you write in the circle’s notebook changes what Jodi says after the baby arrives.
Made by Brazilian creators. [b]Brazilian Portuguese is the default language. An English edition is planned as a separate download.[/b]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Four visual stages[/b] across Stardew Valley’s 14-day pregnancy, for the farmer or a pregnant NPC spouse.[/*]
[*][b]Three maternity outfits[/b] that grow with the farmer’s bump, plus a maternity swimsuit for the spa.[/*]
[*][b]A free clothing catalog[/b] presented by Emily during the first gathering.[/*]
[*][b]Primeiro Colo[/b], a maternity boutique near the airport in Downtown Zuzu.[/*]
[*][b]Optional guests[/b] from Ridgeside Village and Stardew Valley Expanded, plus Lúcia from Zuzu.[/*]
[*][b]Solo and co-op support.[/b] Stardew Valley handles birth, adoption, and naming. By default, the mod brings forward the first baby question to the first eligible night.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Extract the entire mod folder into
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]. Keep
[code]Conteudo[/code]and
[code]Nucleo[/code]together inside it.[/*]
[*]If upgrading from an earlier beta, remove the old mod folder before installing this one.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. For co-op, both players should install the same version.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Required[/b] — Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or newer, SMAPI 4.1.5 or newer, and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*][b]Optional[/b] — Downtown Zuzu for the boutique and Lúcia’s appearance, Ridgeside Village for Carmen, and Stardew Valley Expanded for Olivia.[/*]
[/list][heading]Public Beta[/heading]

[heading]Credits[/heading]
Thanks to [b]cptnmatruz[/b] for [i]Haley’s Pregnancy[/i], which inspired the use of props and dialogue choices in the cutscenes. Thanks to the [b]Downtown Zuzu team[/b] for the city and the original storefront used as the basis for Primeiro Colo.

[b]Public Beta[/b]
The Mothers Circle is currently in public beta. If you run into a bug, contact me on Discord at [b]nightgames123[/b]. Please include what happened, which version of the mod you’re using, and a link to your SMAPI log if you have one.
Thanks for playing and helping improve the mod!

Downloads.Description: The complete mod in English, including letters, cutscenes, and shop dialogue. Includes all three new maternity outfits from version 2.1.0. Install one language edition only.
